task.prompt: Supplier is in Delhi. The buyer is billed in Tamil Nadu but, on the buyer's direction, the goods are delivered to Delhi. Which tax applies?

world.rule: goods delivered to a third person on the billed party's direction: place of supply = the BILLED party's state (IGST s.10(1)(b))

rules.freight_rule: ENV RULE: freight and packing on the invoice are taxed at the highest rate among its lines (mixed-supply style; real treatment is usually the principal supply's rate)
rules.rate_regime: 0/5/18/40 (GST 2.0, from 22 Sep 2025); 12% and 28% slabs no longer exist
rules.bill_to_ship_to_rule: goods delivered to a third person on the billed party's direction: place of supply = the BILLED party's state (IGST s.10(1)(b))
rules.rounding: each tax line to 2 decimals half-up; invoice total to nearest rupee with a round_off line
